question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word from the following sentence.**

Encountered

Many people have been experiencing the starting of heat wave and some of them have avoided going outside their homes.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Experiencing'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given word "**encountered**" means **to come across or meet with something, often unexpectedly.**
 
• None of the options provided are direct synonyms of "**encountered**."
 
• However, out of the given options, "**experiencing**" is the** closest in meaning **to "**encountered**," as both suggest** a direct interaction with something**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate synonym from the given **options is 4) Experiencing.**
 
• **Examples:**
 
 
• I **encountered **an old friend on my way to work this morning.
 
• The hikers **encountered **a group of wild animals while trekking through the jungle.
 
• The company **encountered **some unexpected financial difficulties due to a sudden drop in sales.
 
• After the earthquake, many people in the affected areas were **experiencing **a lot of anxiety and fear.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other word's meaning;

 
 
• Outside: to the external side.
 
• Starting: happening or to come into being.
 
• Avoided: keeping away or to stop oneself from doing something.
